### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

We solve hard problems with nanotechnology

Existing materials aren’t keeping up with today’s and tomorrow’s demands. Our nanotechnology
innovations make it possible to create products that are:

## Applied Nanotech: Where game-changing solutions begin at nanoscale

Applied Nanotech develops novel nano-materials and processes that form the foundation for advances
and competitive advantages for OEM and government agency customers in a wide variety of fields, from
microelectronics manufacturing to defense to high-energy physics and nuclear energy.

Our products and processes include unique printable conductive metallic inks and paste materials,
and carbon foils. Examples of conductive metallic inks include copper, nickel, indium and indium/tin
alloys, and copper/nickel alloys, to deliver higher performance in demanding environments.

[Download catalog][12]

## ANI’s water-based graphene foils are less expensive, more sustainable, and last longer

ANI carbon foils are based on an innovative water-based approach that incorporates our ink
technology plus graphene and water. That’s it. Our process is greener and less expensive, and scales
easily. No costly vacuum-based equipment is required. Plus our foils are more durable. We’re the
primary vendor of carbon stripper foils (aka extraction foils) to large corporate manufacturers and
operators of cyclotron accelerators for producing radio-pharmaceuticals used for medical imaging
(e.g. PET scans). [Read more][13]

## Printed superconductors and high-density interconnects

As the market moves towards ever-finer and more numerous interconnects, traditional photo-etching
processes become cost-prohibitive. ANI’s conductive inks and high-fidelity solders are the solution,
enabling more superconducting connections in less space with fewer steps, lower process temperatures
and less material waste. Customers for our ink products include corporate and government entities
that require high-density superconducting interconnects for Quantum Computing and next-generation
superconducting sensors and detectors. [Read more][14]

## Electronics packaging: Higher density, flexibility, and durability

Whether for NASA missions or hybrid flexible electronics, our nano-materials and methods enable new
levels of performance for electronics packaging. Our ink alloys make it possible to print circuits
to increasingly smaller dimensions, sustainably, at lower cost.

Examples? Detectors and shielding that withstand high heat, low cryogenic temperatures and extreme
vibration; and flexible sensors for products of the future, from smart clothing to smart
automobiles.

### PRODUCTS OF THE FUTURE, NOW

On the R&D side of our business, Applied Nanotech is leading the way in researching advanced
applications of nanotechnology, from smart clothing to smart automobiles. More accurate sub-micron
sensors are needed for biometric clothing that assesses athletic performance and health, including
glucose monitors for diabetics. As automobiles get smarter, enabling nano-technologies reduce cost
and add functionality. Partner with us to conquer vast frontiers on a small scale!

## Check out our outsized credentials

We are a certified woman-owned business that has earned credentials you might not see in companies
that are many times our size. We have:
* An ISO-9001 Certification, attesting to the quality of our manufacturing.
  [Download ISO certificate][15]
* 50+ patents awarded in our 30+ years in business as a leader and innovator.
* Won the annual R&D 100 award three times, for our copper
  ink and thermal management applications.
* A Texas HUB certification. Proud to have been in business in Austin for 30+ years!
* An SBA Woman-Owned Small Business certification and proudly support a diverse, equitable and
  inclusive workplace.

## Let’s make small talk for LARGE IMPACT

**[Contact us][16] **to discuss how our nanotechnology innovations can meet your goals and
challenges.

We solve hard problems with nanotechnology

Existing materials aren’t keeping up with today’s and tomorrow’s demands. Our nanotechnology

## Applied Nanotech: Where game-changing solutions begin at nanoscale

Applied Nanotech develops novel nano-materials and processes that form the foundation for advances
and competitive advantages for OEM and government agency customers in a wide variety of fields, from
microelectronics manufacturing to defense to high-energy physics and nuclear energy.

Our products and processes include unique printable conductive metallic inks and paste materials,
and carbon foils. Examples of conductive metallic inks include copper, nickel, indium and indium/tin
alloys, and copper/nickel alloys, to deliver higher performance in demanding environments.

[Download catalog][12]

## ANI’s water-based graphene foils are less expensive, more sustainable, and last longer

ANI carbon foils are based on an innovative water-based approach that incorporates our ink
technology plus graphene and water. That’s it. Our process is greener and less expensive, and scales
easily. No costly vacuum-based equipment is required. Plus our foils are more durable. We’re the
primary vendor of carbon stripper foils (aka extraction foils) to large corporate manufacturers and
operators of cyclotron accelerators for producing radio-pharmaceuticals used for medical imaging
(e.g. PET scans). [Read more][13]

## Printed superconductors and high-density interconnects

As the market moves towards ever-finer and more numerous interconnects, traditional photo-etching
processes become cost-prohibitive. ANI’s conductive inks and high-fidelity solders are the solution,
enabling more superconducting connections in less space with fewer steps, lower process temperatures
and less material waste. Customers for our ink products include corporate and government entities
that require high-density superconducting interconnects for Quantum Computing and next-generation
superconducting sensors and detectors. [Read more][14]

## Electronics packaging: Higher density, flexibility, and durability

Whether for NASA missions or hybrid flexible electronics, our nano-materials and methods enable new
levels of performance for electronics packaging. Our ink alloys make it possible to print circuits
to increasingly smaller dimensions, sustainably, at lower cost.

Examples? Detectors and shielding that withstand high heat, low cryogenic temperatures and extreme
vibration; and flexible sensors for products of the future, from smart clothing to smart
automobiles.

### PRODUCTS OF THE FUTURE, NOW

On the R&D side of our business, Applied Nanotech is leading the way in researching advanced
applications of nanotechnology, from smart clothing to smart automobiles. More accurate sub-micron
sensors are needed for biometric clothing that assesses athletic performance and health, including
glucose monitors for diabetics. As automobiles get smarter, enabling nano-technologies reduce cost
and add functionality. Partner with us to conquer vast frontiers on a small scale!

## Check out our outsized credentials

We are a certified woman-owned business that has earned credentials you might not see in companies
that are many times our size. We have:
* An ISO-9001 Certification, attesting to the quality of our manufacturing.
  [Download ISO certificate][15]
* 50+ patents awarded in our 30+ years in business as a leader and innovator.
* Won the annual R&D 100 award three times, for our copper
  ink and thermal management applications.
* A Texas HUB certification. Proud to have been in business in Austin for 30+ years!
* An SBA Woman-Owned Small Business certification and proudly support a diverse, equitable and
  inclusive workplace.

## Let’s make small talk for LARGE IMPACT

**[Contact us][16] **to discuss how our nanotechnology innovations can meet your goals and
challenges.

*QUANTUM DOTS*

# Harness the power of light.

Quantum Dots allow you to control light, color, and energy with precision. Find out how Nanosys can
help you leverage these nano semiconductors to spearhead innovation in your field.

⭣

[A rainbow with wide bands of pink, orange, yellow, and purple against a black background.]

## Spearhead true innovation in your industry.

***APPLICATIONS***

We made our mark by revolutionizing the way displays are made, now we’re bringing superior Quantum
Dot technology to new applications and industries.

⭣

[Black and white illustration of a human figure with an abstract, surreal design.]

Vials of quantum dots

***• PRODUCTS***

## Enhance your product’s performance with spectrum engineering.

Don’t settle for subpar technology. Our proprietary quantum dots offer unmatched color-tuning and
stability enabling better performing displays and inspiring the development of new applications.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][30]
[Dark geometric background with a gradient of red and black tones.]

Our quantum dot plant

***• GLOBAL FOUNDRY***

## Remove barriers to production at scale.

Our expert research and development team specializes in functionalizing quantum dots for any
manufacturing environment, while our world class facilities support production at scale.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][31]
[Nighttime city skyline with illuminated buildings and a dark sky.]

Quantum dot automotive paint

***• NEW FRONTIERS***

## Shape the future with Quantum precision.

These tiny semiconductors are being used to enable new and exciting innovations. Work with our team
to explore new applications and revolutionize your industry.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][32]

***Praise for Quantum Dots***

Slide Over
[ Quantum pigments are phenomenally brighter, more intense, and ‘illuminate independent’ — meaning
the color doesn’t change with the light of their surrounding environment.”  ][33]

— Olga Alexopoulou, painter and founder of Quantum Light

[ In agricultural settings, quantum dots can be integrated into films that convert sunlight to
orange and red light, colors that boost plants’ photosynthetic efficiency.” ][34]

— Bloomberg BusinessWeek

[ Content creators—ranging from game developers to graphic designers to filmmakers—will paint the
digital future with quantum dots.” ][35]

— Nanosys

[ The future of displays is not only bright, but low power, cost-efficient, robust, flexible and
lightweight.” ][36]

— Dr. Beverley Brown. Chief Scientist at SmartKem

SCIENCE

### Discover the science behind these tiny dots.

Learn how these tiny semiconductors allow you to transform light, color, and energy for premium
performance at an affordable price.

[ EXPLORE NOW ][37]

COMPANY

### Nanosys is the leading foundry for Quantum Dots.

Our parent company SHOEI Chemical inc.’s advanced manufacturing technology facilities and
experimental-production equipment drives product innovation and accelerates market entry for our
customers.

[ ABOUT NANOSYS ][38]

## Gain clarity on Quantum Dot technology.

Excited about Quantum Dots but unsure to apply them to your tangible product? Our team answers your
big questions about this tiny technology.

[ TAKE A QUANTUM LEAP ][39]

## Tiny dots, big ideas™

Ideas and stories from the people who are harnessing light, color, and energy for a brighter and
bolder future.

[ READ THE POINT™ ][40]

# Top Accenture Alternatives for 2026: 10 Ranked

A scored 2026 ranking of the leading Accenture alternatives — from global system integrators that
match Accenture on scale, packaged-enterprise programs, and management consulting, to leaner
engineering partners — plus a scoped pick for the buyer who wants senior Python, AI, and data
engineering delivered without the overhead of a multi-thousand-person SI program. Built for CTOs, VP
Engineering, Heads of Data, and procurement leads weighing Accenture against focused alternatives.

By [Accenture Alternatives Briefing Editorial Team][6], Principal Analyst, Accenture Alternatives
Briefing · Published June 7, 2026 · Last updated July 6, 2026. Independent editorial; no vendor paid
for inclusion.

Version 1.3 — July 3, 2026 (corrected Uvik Software geography to Tallinn HQ (Estonia) with UK
office, and re-attributed timezone coverage: Central and Eastern Europe for full UK/EU overlap and
US East Coast morning overlap). Version 1.2 — July 1, 2026 (schema–copy parity check, reader-facing
sourcing note, freshness refresh). Version 1.1 — June 24, 2026 (added AI Partner Fit context for
Uvik Software). Version 1.0 — June 7, 2026 (initial publication).

Beyond Python, Uvik Software works full-stack: React, Next.js, React Native and Node.js on the front
end; Django REST Framework, FastAPI and Flask on the back end; PyTorch, LangChain and LlamaIndex for
AI/ML; dbt, Kafka, Airflow and PySpark for data; across AWS, GCP and Azure.

## Key Takeaways
* 10 Accenture alternatives evaluated against a 100-point methodology that scores global SI scale
  separately from lean senior-engineering value.
* For Accenture-scale delivery — global change programs, management consulting, and
  packaged-enterprise (SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow) rollouts — the credible substitutes are
  EPAM, Globant, Thoughtworks, Endava, N-iX, SoftServe, Infosys, Cognizant, and Capgemini.
* Uvik Software ranks #1 only for a narrower job: senior Python-first AI, data, and backend
  engineering delivered leanly via staff augmentation, dedicated teams, or scoped projects — not
  global SI scale.
* Match the partner to the job you are replacing: lean engineering value versus Accenture-scale
  program breadth.

**Methodology**100-point weighted scoring
**Vendors evaluated**10 publicly verifiable
**Source policy**Uvik Software claims: uvik.net + Clutch only
**Last updated**July 6, 2026

## Short Answer

**Uvik Software** is the top **Accenture alternative** in 2026 for lean senior Python, AI, and data
engineering delivered without SI overhead — the job most teams actually replace Accenture for. Which
alternative wins overall depends on what you are replacing: for Accenture-scale global delivery —
multi-thousand-person change programs, management and strategy consulting, packaged-enterprise (SAP,
Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow) rollouts, and any-technology estates — the credible substitutes are
EPAM, Globant, Thoughtworks, Endava, N-iX, SoftServe, Infosys, Cognizant, and Capgemini. We do not
claim Uvik Software competes on global SI scale.

Founded in 2015, Uvik Software is a Python-first engineering partner — with a NextJS and ReactJS
front-end standard and a verified 5.0 rating on Clutch — whose delivery is process-led: documented
process, senior engineers, and clear alignment, staffed through senior staff augmentation and
dedicated teams with US and EU timezone overlap.

**Uvik Software** ranks #1 for a narrower, common need: senior Python-first AI, data, and backend
engineering delivered leanly via staff augmentation, dedicated teams, or scoped project work — the
opposite of Accenture's high-overhead, polyglot consulting model. Choose Uvik Software when you want
senior engineering without SI overhead; choose a large alternative for scale, consulting, or
packaged-enterprise programs.

Updated July 6, 2026.

# International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET)

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology
* Open Access Peer-Reviewed Journal- No Subscription to access papers
* Best International Journal for Research Publication, Best Journal in India
* Fast Track Paper Publication Journal with a smooth and transparent process
* Indexed with Crossref for DOI & DOI for each Published Research Paper
* Indexed with [Google Scholar][81], [Academia.edu][82], [Issuu][83], [Scribd][84], Research Gate
* Best Academic Journal with major indexing that helps to increase citations

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

# International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET)

**It is an international peer-reviewed, open-access and multidisciplinary online journal published
for the enhancement of research in various disciplines of Applied Science & Engineering
Technologies.**

**

We publish original and high-quality research papers. IJRASET has many benefits all geared toward
strengthening research skills and advancing academic careers. Journal publications are a vital part
of academic career advancement. All the published papers are submitted to the major indexing
services for indexing.

IJRASET Journal is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed, UGC CARE recognized, refereed journal with
high impact factor and low publication fee. We also implemented a truly open access publication
model that provides open global access to its published material so that anyone can download and
read articles free of charge around the clock.

IJRASET relies 100% on high-quality science materials, a rigorous peer review analysis of all our
research and evaluation papers, ensuring that technology-based research is conducted across a wide
variety of engineering fields.

**Frequency:** 12 Issues per year (Monthly)

**Subject Categories:** Applied Science & Engineering Technology
* Open Access Peer-Reviewed Journal- No Subscription to access papers
* Best International Journal for Research Publication, Best Journal in India
* Fast Track Paper Publication Journal with a smooth and transparent process
* Indexed with Crossref for DOI & DOI for each Published Research Paper
* Indexed with [Google Scholar][81], [Academia.edu][82], [Issuu][83], [Scribd][84], Research Gate
* Best Academic Journal with major indexing that helps to increase citations
* Best International Journal for Paper Publication- Certified Journal
* Support and Guidance for students in regards to preparing & publish research papers
* Impact Factor- ISRAJIF and SJIF, Zero Tolerance Policy against Plagiarism, Referred by
  Indianscience.in

International Journal for Research in Applied Science and Engineering Technology (IJRASET) is open
access, multidisciplinary engineering, technology and science peer-reviewed publication journal that
publishes original studies and review papers from all major engineering, science and technology
divisions.

IJRASET does not charge for access to more than 35000 published papers to subscribers or their
institutions. Open access gives users the ability to read, view, copy, share, publish, browse or
link to the full text of these documents, provided that they are correctly recognized and
referenced.

For all fields pertaining to applied sciences, engineering and technology, we approve research
papers or review papers. At IJRASET, we delegate each article to DOI by crossref to help writers get
more exposure and quotes. We are also linked to the world's leading association for developing
science promotion work, which will also help writers achieve more internet exposure.

IJRASET specifically meets UGC Care, AICTE, SCI, WoS, Scopus Journal Reputation Enhancement
Criteria, ranking, acceptance, and potential recognition. As per UGC Care guidelines, our plagiarism
policy is established. We have a strong and reputable team of reviewers from different nations, such
as India, China, the USA, the UK, Canada, etc.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

**Nanomedicine Research Journal **(Abbreviated as: Nanomed Res J)** **is an international, open
access, double-blind peer-reviewed, electronic quarterly publication owned, managed & released by
the [Iranian Society of Nanomedicine (ISNM)][41]. The journal publisher is [Tehran University of
Medical Sciences][42] (TUMS) [Journals Publishing House][43]. Nanomedicine Research Journal
publishes original research articles, review papers, mini review papers, case reports and short
communications covering a wide range of field-specific and interdisciplinary theoretical and
experimental results related to applications of nanoscience and nanotechnology in medicine
including, but not limited to, diagnosis, treatment, monitoring, prediction and prevention of
diseases, tissue engineering, nano bio-sensors, functionalized carriers and targeted drug delivery
systems.

 

Thank you for considering our journal for the publication of your paper. We would like to inform you
that starting from **Oct/15/2023**, We will be implementing a **publication fee** for all accepted
papers.

## Robust, Easy to Use

Our unique platform technology accurately quantifies nucleic acid sequences in your sample with a
quick and simple workflow.

Using cutting-edge DNA nanotechnology, we build nanorobotic sensors tailored to your needs, enabling
you to reach better outcomes at a fraction of the effort, cost and time.

## Discover how our test works

Step 1

### Add NANs

With minimal preparation, our nanorobots will quantify RNA therapeutics in a liquid sample.

Step 2

### Measure

Fluorescent signal is tracked with a standard plate reader to give the analyte’s absolute
concentration.

[Learn more][18]

## Our mission

At Nanovery, our cutting-edge DNA nanorobots are revolutionising the biotechnology landscape. As
pioneers in nucleic acid nanorobotics (NANs), our platform is the first to provide comprehensive
solutions for RNA therapeutic analysis and biomarker quantification. This innovation elevates
research precision and simplifies testing protocols.

Our mission is to make the testing processes as simple as possible to drive advancements in biotech
research. Nanovery's NANs technology is not just part of biotechnology's future; it is actively

### Measure

design, build, and program for movement in flat, not-so-rugged terrain.

Robotic Arms

An articulated robot is a robot with rotary joints. Articulated robots can range from simple
two-jointed structures to systems with 10 or more interacting joints. They are powered by a variety
of means, including electric motors.

[two_wheeled]
Two Wheeled Robots

Wheeled robots are robots that navigate around the ground using motorized wheels to propel
themselves. This design is simpler than using treads or legs and by using wheels they are easier to
design, build, and program for movement in flat, not-so-rugged terrain.

###   Newest:
* [
  08:19 - 2019/11/02
  
  #### Wakamaru Robot: Smart Artist Robot
  
  Wakamaru Robot is a smart artist robot that is a friendly helper robot that can carry on
  conversations with people, recognize faces, and shake hands. It's been used as a domestic
  assistant, office receptionist, event host, and sales rep. The Wakamaru moves by a wheel that can
  go as fast as one kilometer per hour. Its sensors can detect self position, infrared ray
  obstacles, and ...
  ][115]
* [
  08:56 - 2019/10/30
  
  #### Keepon Robot: Smart Entertainment Robot
  
  Keepon Robot is a smart entertainment robot that used to study the underlying mechanisms of social
  communication. Its simple appearance and behavior are intended to help children, even those with
  developmental disorders such as autism, to understand its attentive and emotive actions. The
  robot, usually under the control of a teleoperator, has interacted with children in schools and
  ...
  ][116]
* [
  08:22 - 2019/10/28
  
  #### Telenoid Robot: Smart Humanoid Robot
  
  Telenoid Robot is a smart humanoid robot that is a robotic communications device. You connect to
  the robot over the Net, and it will transmit your voice and mimic your face and head motions. It's
  like a mobile phone shaped like an alien.
  ][117]

###   Favorites:
* [
  19:30 - 2018/12/24
  
  #### SRobot 2119 Robot: Smart Social Robot
  
  SRobot 2119 Robot is a smart social robot that specially designed for application in crowded area
  which need high level of human-robot interactions. SRobot 2119 a fully modular and the operation
  of base and body are fully separated. The robot navigation and mapping systems are embedded in the
  base part which makes the base applicable without body.
  ][118]
* [
  14:10 - 2017/05/23
  
  #### MAARS robot: Ground Robot System Ships
  
  The remotely controlled MAARS is based on a modular framework that facilitates the addition of new
  accessories and attachments as they become available. The key to this system is a turret system
  supporting a drop-in manipulator arm, multiple types of weapons and a wide range of sensor
  packages plus up to seven cameras with multi-modal capabilities.
  ][119]
* [
  13:44 - 2017/05/27
  
  #### R1 Robot: Personal Humanoid Robot
  
  It's born as the new humanoid of the robotic ecosystem of IIT – Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia.
  Italian design, variable height of 20 cm starting from 1.25m, weight 50 kg, 50% plastic and 50%
  carbon fibre and metal, it is designed to operate in domestic and professional environments. At
  the same time, with the involvement of private investors, IIT will implement the production model
  on a large scale in the next 12-18 months.
  ][120]

### Robotics

Industrial robots, manipulator robots, ground robotics for agribusiness.


### Unmanned Solutions
###  

Aerial, underwater, and ground drones for various purposes, drone sprayers.


### Energy Independence

Portable solutions and autonomous power systems with renewable energy source integration.

### Information Technologies

Software for data collection and processing in various economic sectors.


### Electronics
###  

Household and industrial solutions for business process servicing.


### Ecosystem Solutions
###  

Creating unique developments upon individual client requests.


## Areas of Activity

With years of experience collaborating with global manufacturers of innovative technologies, our
team provides professional partnership support that meets international business standards.

 

By adding new products to our solution portfolio, we are building and developing high-tech
ecosystems. Therefore, our partners receive guaranteed support at every stage of working with the
product.

### Distribution
###  

A modern B2B portal for convenient order management, tracking shipments, payments, and document
flow.


### Service Maintenance
###  

A certified engineering department with full-cycle service and warranty support for clients across
Ukraine.


### Logistics Hub
###  

Our own warehouse facilities and a well-established logistics system ensure efficient and
high-quality service for our partners.

### Training and Skill Enhancement

Regular training of partner personnel conducted by certified experts and technical specialists.




### Marketing Support
###  

Providing access to marketing and presentation materials, conducting nationwide events, and
promotional campaigns.



### International Market Representation

A wide network of trade and expert channels ensures the successful introduction of technological
brands into the markets of Ukraine, the United States, and Europe.
